title: Points Availability and Validity Periods in Paloma Rewards
content:
Three Paloma Rewards periods govern the life of a point: how long after it is earned it becomes redeemable, how long a month's points last, and how long a membership may go without a qualifying transfer before its remaining points lapse.

| Tier | Calendar days after delivery before earned points become redeemable | Calendar months after the month of earning at whose end points expire | Months without a completed qualifying transfer after which every remaining point expires |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | 14 | 12 | 12 |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | 14 | 12 | 12 |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | 7 | 18 | 18 |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | 7 | 18 | 18 |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | 3 | 24 | 24 |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | 0 | 24 | 36 |

## Reading the periods

- **Earning delay**: earned points are held back from redemption for the number of calendar days shown, counted from the date they were earned (the delivery date). On Paloma Rewards Elite the delay is 0 days, so points are redeemable on the day they are earned.
- **Points expiry**: all points earned in one calendar month expire together, at the end of the month that lies the stated number of months later.
- **Inactivity expiry**: when no qualifying transfer has completed for the stated number of months, every point still held expires.

## Worked figures (hypothetical dates)

- Points earned in March 2026 under a 12-month expiry expire at the end of March 2027; under an 18-month expiry, at the end of September 2027; under a 24-month expiry, at the end of March 2028.
- Paloma Rewards Elite is the only tier whose inactivity period (36 months) is longer than its points expiry period (24 months); on every other tier the two periods are equal.
